**After payroll:** The assistant should make sure the HR Manager is told on Monday (or by email) that Ryan’s termination letter was triggered automatically by a second probationary UA, and that the free-text note explains the mitigating circumstances. Any decision to exercise discretion or reconsider the termination would have to come from someone with authority, not from recoding the absence.
